special_priority_darshan.daily_quota: Up to 1,000 tokens per day (released monthly in advance online)
special_priority_darshan.cooling_off_period: Once availed, the privilege can only be accessed again after 90 days

slots_and_timings.slot_name: Morning Slot (Subject to TTD Quota Schedule)

reporting_venue.name: Senior Citizen & Differently-Abled Waiting Complex
reporting_venue.location: Near Supatham Entrance / Opposite SV Museum, South Mada Street, Tirumala
reporting_venue.amenities: Air-conditioned sitting galleries, free hot milk, coffee, tea, sambar rice, accessible toilets, and medical assistance staff

senior_citizens.mandatory_document: Original Government Photo ID (Aadhaar Card preferred) showing complete Date of Birth
senior_citizens.spouse_rule: If either husband or wife is 65+ years old, the spouse is permitted to accompany as an attendant regardless of age

differently_abled.mandatory_document: Valid Medical Disability Certificate / UDID Card issued by Central/State Medical Board along with original Photo ID

eligible_conditions: Severe Spine Surgery (Unable to walk long distances)
medical_cases.mandatory_document: Valid discharge summary or medical certificate issued by the concerned surgeon/specialist along with original Photo ID

attendant_policy.general_rule: Only spouse is permitted automatically for 65+ senior citizens and medical cases
attendant_policy.super_senior_citizens: 1 dedicated attendant/helper allowed for pilgrims aged 80+ years
attendant_policy.differently_abled_attendant: 1 dedicated attendant permitted if disability certificate mandates continuous assistance

wheelchair_assistance.manual_wheelchairs: Free manual wheelchairs available at South Mada Street, Supatham entrance, VQC-2, and PACs
wheelchair_assistance.motorized_wheelchairs: Free battery-operated wheelchairs with trained Srivari Sevak volunteer assistants
wheelchair_assistance.deposit_policy: No rental fee; available on a first-come, first-served basis at major entry gates

battery_buggies.coverage_routes: Continuous service running between CRO, Tirumala Bus Stand, PACs, SV Museum, and Temple Entry Gates
battery_buggies.priority_boarding: Reserved exclusively for elderly, disabled, pregnant women, and parents with infants

physical_accessibility.ramps_and_flooring: Gentle barrier-free non-slip ramps, tactile flooring, and stainless steel support handrails throughout the queue lines
physical_accessibility.sanctum_access: Dedicated hydraulic lifts, escalator bridges, and direct ramp access bypassing steps directly into the Mahadwaram and inner sanctum
